runtime_usage: front-facing Live2D / click-reaction / cut-in source concept; not a final layered Live2D PSD and not a rear-view in-battle companion sheet

generator.prompt_summary: Front-facing Live2D-ready red baby dragon Ringpet, preserving red scales, gold horns, cream belly, small wings, curled tail, cyan-gold resonance ring collar, and glowing chest ring-core; small flame held near one paw on a flat magenta background.

prompt.asset_type: front-facing Live2D source concept for a Ringpet / Lingpet companion in DiskHearts - Ringpia
prompt.primary_request: Create a front-facing Live2D-ready source drawing of the red fire baby dragon Ringpet on a flat magenta background.
prompt.subject: one tiny SD chibi baby dragon Ringpet, full-body front view, mostly symmetrical rig-friendly pose; head faces forward, eyes visible and cute, small snout, small open mouth prepared for fire-breathing expressions; arms slightly away from torso, wings open behind without hiding the body, legs and feet visible, curled tail visible around the lower body without covering the belly
prompt.ringpet_identity: prominent glowing cyan-gold resonance ring collar around the neck/shoulders, clear circular ring-core gem on the chest, small circular resonance accents, egg-hatched magical companion read
prompt.fire_motif: tiny contained red/crimson flame wisp near one side of the mouth or held near one paw, not covering the face, mouth, chest core, arms, or wings
prompt.style: polished 2D Korean anime game mascot art, clean cel-shaded SD creature, crisp readable silhouette, high-quality front model sheet feeling
prompt.background: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff magenta chroma-key background only
prompt.constraints: no rear view, no side view, no giant portrait crop, no complex overlapping effects, no flame covering the mouth or eyes, no extra characters, no UI frame, no text, no watermark

postprocess.note: Transparent art was extracted from the generated near-magenta source. The magenta source was recomposited from the transparent PNG onto exact opaque #ff00ff.

ringpet_rule_audit.reason: Live2D / click-reaction source art intentionally uses a front-facing expression-readable pose. This differs from Maribo-style rear/rear-three-quarter in-battle companion sheets, which still require AutoSprite-derived 5x5/25-frame runtime sheets before catalog wiring.
ringpet_rule_audit.next_runtime_step: If promoted to runtime, split/animate through the Live2D-style pingpong sheet pipeline or use as an identity anchor for separate companion walk/strike/cast AutoSprite sheets.
